before: A merge restart that no row continued counted as an ordinary cell. A row of continuations beside bottom-to-top text cells took the tallest end-of-cell paragraph of its cells. A first bottom-to-top cell gave no spacing before.
after: That restart counts as a merge head, so its row takes the first-cell floor. A row of continuations and bottom-to-top cells takes its first cell's end-of-cell paragraph, or only its atLeast minimum when it has one. A first bottom-to-top cell counts its spacing before.
reason: The change is in table row layout and layout reuse only. Shared state, operations, and synchronization are unchanged.
